name: Galgagyörk (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Galgagyörk (a blue shield with yellow ears of grain and a white ploughshare) below the name GALGAGYÖRK in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
